Download the file for your system, start it, and BitMerger opens in your browser.

| System | File |
|---|---|
| macOS (Apple Silicon: M1, M2, M3 …) | `bitmerger-macos-apple-silicon` |
| macOS (Intel) | `bitmerger-macos-intel` |
| Windows | `bitmerger-windows-x64.exe` |
| Linux | `bitmerger-linux-x64` / `bitmerger-linux-arm64` |

The binaries are not signed yet. See the README for the one-time "open anyway" step.
`SHA256SUMS` lets you verify the downloads.
